verdict.rationale: A probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404). However, Riveter publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.riveterhq.com/openapi.yaml that includes agent-friendly prose, such as "Prefer webhooks over polling" and its MCP-assistant usage note, so an agent can be pointed at structured API docs. The JSON OpenAPI paths all 404, and nothing shows docs written specifically for agents. Missing for 10: a published llms.txt/llms-full.txt, explicitly agent-oriented documentation, and independent confirmation that agents consume the docs successfully.
